sessions.verification: read 2026-11-11: 87 clusters from 2 up on 12 shanks, every one in hc-3's cell table for gor01-6-7 (3 listed units have no spike here); the last spike at 2587.80 s against hc-3's 2587.808 s session length; fig1.nel's 258,427 spike times fall within 1 us of an hc-3 detected spike for 95.3% (none shifted 0.1 s, 3.0% shifted 1 s); its pos2d support is 2 intervals, 0-1180 s and 1250-2580 s, as nelpy's hc-3 table gives them

sampling_rate.source: Maboudi et al. 2018's fig1.nel: pos2d's _fs is 60.00000000005457 and its samples are 1/60 s apart; nelpy's hc-3 reader reads Diba's .whl files at fs=60. No source read states the camera rate

position_span.source: Diba & Buzsáki 2007's Supplementary Methods: tracks of 79, 125 and 170 cm with 21 x 21 cm end platforms (121 to 212 cm in all); Maboudi et al. 2018: tracks 150 or 200 cm long (192 to 242 cm). The head reaches past the platforms' edges, so the largest span of the tracked positions must lie within 120 to 300 cm

speed_limit.source: Iriarte-Díaz 2002, J. Exp. Biol. 205:2897-2908, Table 1: Rattus runs at most 13.78 body lengths/s at a 0.190 m body length, 2.62 m/s (from Garland 1983 and Nowak 1999); times 1.5 because the tracked point is a head-mounted LED, which swings faster than the body, and no source read states head speed
